root_cause.text: In sync_linked_regs(), the register's id is overwritten with known_reg's id (which may be BPF_ADD_CONST after an addition) instead of being preserved, breaking the link between linked registers and preventing subsequent bound propagation.
root_cause.evidence: The commit description states "sync_linked_regs() copies the id of known_reg to reg when propagating bounds...now reg gets BPF_ADD_CONST from the copy" and that this causes reg to get a new id upon a later move, breaking the link. The fix preserves reg->id alongside off and subreg_def, as shown in the patch diff which adds `u32 saved_id = reg->id;` and restores it: `reg->id = saved_id;`.
